title: Non-destructive spectral preprocessing overlay
description: Structural analog of data.apply_operation/undo_operation/etc (see analysis/data/overlay.py) applied to spectral reflectance arrays instead of dataframe columns. `reflectance_raw` in spectra.parquet is NEVER mutated — every op carries a `scope` ({"all":true} or {"spectrum_ids":[...]}) and is validated against the current effective spectrum before being persisted (invalid ops never get appended). See analysis/spectrometry/preprocessing.py for the full operation list (remove_invalid_values, select_range, remove_bands, interpolate_gaps, smooth, normalize, baseline_correct, continuum_remove, reflectance_to_absorbance, absorbance_to_reflectance, derivative, correct_splice, resample).
